title: PIXL 8000 Watermelon Ice Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Watermelon Ice PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod captures the fresh, delicately sweet taste of ripe Watermelon complemented by a cool, icy finish. The result is a crisp, refreshing vape that stays bright and clean from first puff to last. Each 2ml pod contains 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and connects to a 10ml refill reservoir in the PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, automatically refilling as you vape to deliver up to 8000 puffs per kit. Mesh coil technology maintains consistent flavour and vapour, while the MTL draw ensures a satisfying, easy inhale.
